remarks: Spacious 3/3 double located in Buffalo West Side offering rare underground garage parking for two cars. Each unit features a bright and inviting living room, formal dining room, large kitchen, three bedrooms, full bath and ample storage throughout. The lower unit includes the convenience of in-unit laundry, while the upper unit offers a desirable walk-in pantry. The partially finished third floor attic provides additional versatile space perfect for storage or future expansion. Full basement with solid mechanicals, additional laundry hookups, and direct access to the garage. Recent updates include a metal roof, lower furnace and hot water tank, first floor laundry, updated flooring, and a newer water line to the street. Showings begin 5/6.
